plain_statement: It is false that: Let C be a circuit of AND and OR gates on n inputs, C' any circuit, both reading only earlier wires, and s a map on wire numbers fixing every input, sending each gate of C to a gate of C'. Suppose every gate of C except gate m is copied: its image has the same operation and reads the images of its wires. Fix an input x. If the image of gate m is true at x only when gate m is, the same holds for every gate of C; and if the image of gate m equals gate m at x, every gate equals its image at x.
